title_en: Finding olive oil in a supermarket

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me — I'm after some olive oil. Which aisle is that in?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Aisle 6, next to the pasta. Want me to show you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: No need, thanks. One more thing — is the organic brand still on sale?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: The organic one's out of stock today, I'm afraid. But the regular bottles are on special offer: buy one, get one free.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Perfect. I'll stock up on those then. Thanks for your help.
